# Maxroll viewer fixtures

Captured from the public Maxroll planner profile endpoint for `xf9um40q`
(Blood Wave Endgame Necromancer) and `nq4dbn0q` (Cold Rain of Arrows Rogue
Endgame), and the public `assets-ng.maxroll.gg/d4-tools/game/data.min.json`
game metadata on 2026-10-08. Game version: `3.1.3.73224`.

The fixtures retain source variant names, item records, skill coordinates,
connections, reward IDs and ranks, board grids, source rotations, allocations,
glyphs and levels. Unrelated game records and source tooltip prose/formulas are
omitted. These are operational schema fixtures, not copies of guide articles.
Tests compare each diagram's allocation set to every source variant and step.
The source does not specify a point-by-point paragon spending order.
